question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds / 1000.0 / 60.0) as min_minutes,
    MAX(Milliseconds / 1000.0 / 60.0) as max_minutes,
    AVG(Milliseconds / 1000.0 / 60.0) as avg_minutes
  FROM Track
),
boundaries AS (
  SELECT 
    min_minutes,
    avg_minutes,
    max_minutes,
    (min_minutes + avg_minutes) / 2.0 as short_upper,
    (avg_minutes + max_minutes) / 2.0 as medium_upper
  FROM stats
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds / 1000.0 / 60.0 as duration_minutes,
    b.short_upper,
    b.medium_upper,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds / 1000.0 / 60.0 <= b.short_upper THEN 'short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds / 1000.0 / 60.0 <= b.medium_upper THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'long'
    END as category
  FROM Track t, boundaries b
)
SELECT 
  category,
  MIN(duration_minutes) as min_time,
  MAX(duration_minutes) as max_time,
  SUM(ile.UnitPrice * ile.Quantity) as total_revenue
FROM classified c
JOIN InvoiceLine ile ON c.TrackId = ile.TrackId
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category
